task.title: P6-150: Decide what a tray entry means across copies, entries, grain and quantity
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Selection tray and batch move). Original id: P6-150. Size: L, decision first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Settle what a tray entry means — copies vs. entries, grain, and quantity — as one decision** (was `P6-046a` + `P6-046b` + `P6-046c` + `P6-062`; these cannot be answered separately). Today: the tray counts **entries, not copies**, so a selected row holding 4 reads "1 card" (`selection_tray.rs:360-366`); multi-grain rows (`holding_id == None` with `present > 0` — a cell summing several finish/condition/language holdings) are **selectable** (`collection.rs:1345`) even though `Held { collection, printing, board }` cannot say which grain, which is the exact reason the count stepper already refuses those cells (`collection.rs:1445-1453`); the same physical card selected from `/my` (oracle grain) and from a collection row (held grain) yields two indistinguishable tray entries reading "2 cards"; and batch move is one copy per entry, fixed server-side (`SELECTION_MOVE_QUANTITY = 1`, `lib.rs:1109`, `:1161`), with `SelectedCard` carrying no quantity — which is why the toast says "(1 copy each)" and is honest today rather than wrong. Deciding the label's meaning decides all four.
